svg.title: Default pin maps of the supported boards
svg.desc: Header pinouts of the Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3, ESP32-C3-DevKitM-1, ESP32-DevKitC V4 and ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1, each pin tagged with its default role in this firmware: PWM channels, 1-Wire, button, LEDs, UART, and pins to avoid (strapping, flash, USB, input only, PSRAM).
svg.text: header order as printed on each board; tags show the firmware default for that pin (all editable in Settings)
Front view, USB-C up. One channel (D1) enabled by default.
No user LED. Attach the u.FL antenna.
Top view, module up. J1 left, J3 right.
IO8 (RGB LED) and IO9 (BOOT) are also strapping pins.
Top view, antenna up. J2 left, J3 right.
wire by GPIO number, not position.
Top view, module up. J1 left, J3 right.
Status blink uses GPIO 48: works on v1.0 boards only.
* used by octal PSRAM on N8R8 / N16R8 modules.
avoid: strapping · flash · USB · input only
